full_judgment: 2. The facts, relevant for disposal of this petition, are that the present respondents as plaintiffs instituted. Title Suit No.94 of 2016 in the Court of Joint District Judge, Barguna for setting aside the ex-parte decree dated 25.09.2012 passed by the First Court of Joint District Judge, Barguna in Title Suit No.10 of 2009. In the suit, the plaintiffs, on 10.01.2017, filed an application for staying further proceedings of Execution Case No.04 of 2016 arising out of Title Suit No.10 of 2009. The learned Judge of the trial Court rejected such application for stay and also dis-missed the suit summarily at this initial stage stating that the suit is not maintain-able. Against such order of dismissal, the plaintiff who was defendant in partition suit being No.10 of 2009 moved before the High Court Division and obtained Rule which was made absolute subsequently. The plaintiff in original suit being No.10 of 2009 as petitioner filed the present petition for leave to appeal. The case of the plaintiffs, in short, is that the suit lands originally belonged to Chhaferuddin, Hochanuddin and others. Their names were correctly recorded in CS Khatian mentioning their respective shares. The said recorded tenants and Hochanuddin while enjoying and possessing the suit land, Hochanuddin died leaving behind two wives, namely, Chhahera Bibi and Kadbhanu Bibi. Kadbhanu Bibi gave birth to one son, namely, Amzat Ali and three daughters, namely, Bibishan, Kulsum and Orful. Other wife, Chhahera Bibi gave birth to two sons, namely, Afchher Ali and Hazrat Ali and 4(four) daughters, namely, Gedi Bibi, Duli Bibi, Barojan, Alekjan. One of the wives, namely, Chhahera Bibi got married to a recorded tenant, Chhaferuddin. The daughter of Hochanuddin named Bibishan died leaving behind 4(four) daughters, namely, Hamida, Rokeya, Rahila and Habibunnessa along with mother named Kadbhanu, one brother Amzad Ali and two sisters, namely, Kulsum and Orful. Kulsum died leaving behind her full sister, Orful Bibi and step brother Hazrat Ali and Orful Bibi died leaving behind only son, Abdur Rahim and only daughter, Chherjan Bibi. Amzad Ali died leaving behind his mother, Kadbhanu, two full sisters, namely, Kulsum and Orful Bibi.
